# tests/fixtures/html — Web pages for article mode (feature 004)

Generated by `../builders/html.py` (`build_html`, run by `../build_fixtures.py`); rebuilding gives the same bytes.

| File | What it is for |
|---|---|
| `news.html` | an article with every construct of the subset, inside a menu, a cookie banner, an aside and a footer (each marked `*-FIXTURE`, which article mode must remove) |
| `no_article.html` | a login form and a few links: no article, so the full page and a note |
| `hostile.html` | an article whose text, links and markup try to become HTML, links, images and blocks |
